topic: Write a report about an event at your school or workplace.
text:
Report on the School Film Evening

The purpose of this report is to describe the film evening which was organised in our school last friday. Over 80 students was present in the main hall. The evening started at 6 pm and the film was began at half past six.

Students could choosed between two films: a comedy and a documentary about the ocean. Most of people voted for the comedy, so it was showed. The atmosphere was very good, everybody were laughing during the whole film.

However, there was some problems. Firstly, the sound was to quiet for the students in the back. Secondly the snacks run out after only twenty minutes, what made some students angry.

In conclusion, the evening was a success and I recommend to organise it again. Next time, we should buy more snacks and check the sound system before. In my opinion, it would be also good to let students to choose the film earlier.
